construction_notes.text: From the state Housing Element Annual Progress Report, through 2025.

State Annual Progress Report rows for 2019, 2020 and 2021 list "The Bowl Duplexes and Triplexes" at 4000 Palmetto, tracking number 2019-028, application submitted 2019-10-01, 29 proposed for-sale units (2 very-low-income and 2 moderate-income deed-restricted, 25 above-moderate). The 2021 row shows application status Pending.

CEQAnet shows two City of Pacifica Notices of Preparation for a Pacifica Bowl EIR (SCH 1999122078) on vacant, bowl-shaped land on the east side of the 4000 block of Palmetto Avenue south of the Daly City line: 1999-12-22 for 30 units on about 4.2 acres (APNs listed as 009-402-520 and 009-402-260), and 2001-12-27 for 43 single-family homes and townhomes with access from Palmetto Avenue and Edgemar Road (APNs 009-402-250 and 009-402-260).
